payload.rationale: The packet directly shows the Part I Section A table for Outfall 001 with mass-limit and concentration-limit columns. For cadmium, every mass-limit cell and the 30-DAY AVG and DAILY MAX concentration cells are N/A; the 7-DAY AVG (mg/L) cell is Report, not a numeric value. Measurement is quarterly grab sampling. Within the same table, pollutants with enforceable numeric limits carry explicit numbers (e.g., cyanide 0.817 lbs/day, 14.67 ug/L, 22 ug/L), while cadmium follows the same Report-only pattern as other pollutants without numeric caps. The introductory authorization language is general boilerplate; the cadmium row itself specifies no numeric effluent limitation in any averaging period and instead imposes reporting plus monitoring frequency and sample type. This establishes a monitoring-and-reporting requirement without an enforceable numeric limit for compliance comparison, not merely absence inferred from missing data elsewhere.
